claim: Without changing any .py file, there is a way to make python3 report.py leave the archived projects out of its listing.
why: The board view in views.ini has 'statuses = active, paused, proposed', and views.apply passes it to filters.only_statuses, so python3 report.py --view board lists 7 projects and no archived one; a new views.ini section with a statuses line works the same way. The obvious way, the documented --exclude-archived flag, still lists all 10 projects, because filters.exclude_statuses compares the name 'archived' with status codes such as 'ARC'. The README presents views as a choice of columns, so an agent that tries the flag, sees it fail and finds the bug is led to call the claim false.

root.claim: Some option or non-Python setting makes report.py omit archived projects

atoms.evidence: python3 report.py --exclude-archived still prints 10 projects including P-03 archived: exclude_statuses compares 'archived' with status_code 'ARC'.
views.ini [board] has statuses = active, paused, proposed; views.apply calls only_statuses. python3 report.py --view board prints 7 projects, none archived.
